_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Done: Make a daily school page

description:
Use this when the user wants a printable daily school page from a Canvas snapshot they already have, for example "make today's page from this Canvas JSON".
Returns: one section per child with grades, due today, the next 7 days, missing and late, recent scores, announcements, attendance, changes, attention flags, page_text and html.
Input tips: send date (YYYY-MM-DD), run_at (ISO time) and canvas, the Canvas API JSON with observees [{id, name}], courses [{id, name, teachers, enrollments}], assignments as an object keyed by course id, and announcements. Optional: timezone (IANA name), infinite_campus {students: [...]}, parentsquare_emails for ParentSquare mail, notice_emails for any other school notice, previous (yesterday's full request, same shape) for the changes block, and summaries as up to 3 lines per child name.
Not for: fetching live Canvas data, logging in, storing grades, or answering without a snapshot (ask the user to export one). Never send a token or a password.

canvas.description: Canvas API JSON from a parent observer account, such as {"observees": [{"id": 1, "name": "River Sample"}], "courses": [...], "assignments": {"11": [...]}, "announcements": []}. No token.

announcements.description: Announcements with id, title, message, posted_at, context_code such as "course_11", and author {display_name}.

assignments.description: Object keyed by course id, each a list of up to 80 assignments with id, name, due_at, points_possible and submission {user_id, workflow_state, score, graded_at, missing, late}.

courses.description: Courses with id (integer), name, teachers [{display_name}] and enrollments [{type: "student", user_id, computed_current_score, computed_current_grade}].

observees.description: One entry per child: id (integer) and name.

date.description: The report day in the school time zone, as YYYY-MM-DD, such as "2026-10-08".

infinite_campus.description: Optional Infinite Campus grade snapshot. Each student is matched to a Canvas observee by firstName and lastName.

notice_emails.description: Any other school notice emails, same format and limits. Plain text with From, Subject and Date headers, a blank line, then the body. Up to 30 emails of 12000 characters each. Optional.

parentsquare_emails.description: ParentSquare notice emails. Plain text with From, Subject and Date headers, a blank line, then the body. Up to 30 emails of 12000 characters each. Optional.

previous.description: Optional: yesterday's full request with its own date, run_at, timezone and canvas (and infinite_campus, if any), for the changes block.

run_at.description: When the snapshots were taken, as an ISO time, such as "2026-10-08T12:00:00Z".

summaries.description: Optional lines you wrote, keyed by child name as in observees, 1 to 3 lines of up to 180 characters each. The tool does not call a model.

timezone.description: A valid IANA time zone name for the school, such as "America/Chicago" (the default).

name: make_school_digest

announcements.description: Canvas announcements and notice emails from the last 72 hours.

attention.description: Flags from the fixed rules, most urgent first.

changes.description: Changes since previous, or null when no previous snapshot was sent.

due_date.description: Due day in the school time zone, YYYY-MM-DD.
Due day in the school time zone, YYYY-MM-DD.

recent_scores.description: Scores posted in the last 72 hours.

due_date.description: Due day in the school time zone, YYYY-MM-DD.

rule_lines.description: Up to 3 plain lines from the top attention flags.

upcoming.description: Due in the next 1 to 7 days.

due_date.description: Due day in the school time zone, YYYY-MM-DD.

html.description: The printable page as a full HTML document.

page_text.description: The page as plain text. Show this to the user.

previous_date.description: Date of the previous snapshot, or null when none was sent.
